mode_note: Dataset passed the data-adequacy gate; conclusions may reference real-market behavior.
hypothesis: When price begins an unusually strong directional movement, the conditional distribution of the next short horizon is sufficiently directional and persistent to create positive net expectancy after spread, commission, slippage, and latency.

hypothesis_specification.question: Does an unusually strong directional movement predict positive net expectancy at the declared short horizons?
hypothesis_specification.mechanism: short-horizon directional persistence after an impulse, rather than unconditional continuation
hypothesis_specification.measurable_prediction: impulse events have higher continuation and net-return distributions than the matched non-event baseline after declared costs
hypothesis_specification.null_hypothesis: impulse events have no incremental predictive value versus the matched baseline after costs and timing controls
competing_explanations: cost assumptions masking unavailable broker execution evidence
falsification_criteria: chronological validation does not replicate the effect
the effect disappears under declared cost or latency sensitivity
the effect is not separated from baseline/placebo controls
event counts or regime coverage remain insufficient for the claim
required_data: measured bid/ask or tick spread and execution-cost fields
enough events per direction across multiple regimes
untouched chronological validation and forward observation
hypothesis_specification.population: XAUUSD 15m bars from the declared venue/source
hypothesis_specification.regime: all declared volatility regimes; no unmeasured regime may be silently excluded

checks.description: Data must be REAL broker/exchange history — synthetic or simulated data cannot support claims about real-market behavior
Minimum number of bars for event-count sufficiency
Series must span enough calendar time to contain multiple volatility regimes
Real-time impulse claims require recent data (stale data cannot describe current market microstructure)
checks.minimum: last bar within 7 days of assessment time

checks.description: Real spread/bid-ask/tick history is required to replace declared cost ASSUMPTIONS with broker-observed costs (bar high-low range is only a proxy)
checks.minimum: bid/ask or tick data with real spread history available
checks.observed: OHLC bars only — no bid/ask, no ticks (costs remain ESTIMATED assumptions)

checks.description: Enough measured events (per side) for statistical inference after multiple-testing correction

reasons: aggregate evidence is null/weak, but net expectancy is positive in exactly one causal volatility regime and non-positive in the others — any claim must be regime-conditional and requires out-of-sample confirmation per regime
conclusion.promotion: BLOCKED — research artifact only. Lifecycle state unchanged. Not connected to order submission. Demo success never implies live eligibility.
